QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] For the Forest
QuestInfo.0: It seems #bAthena Pierce#k finished reading the letter. Talk to her again.
QuestInfo.1:
The Fairy Queen has been corrupted. She has to be defeated.
Go to the #bQueen's Hiding Place#k in #bFairy Forest 2#k and defeat the Fairy Queen #bEphenia#k.
QuestInfo.2:
Athena Pierce was hesitant in beheading her, but Perzen made the decision for the sake of the forest.
When you returned after taking Ephenia's life, Athena Pierce said you did the right thing with a sad look.
